sections.title: Roof replacement contractor in Edinburg
paras: Edel Roofing is based in Edinburg and has replaced roofs across Hidalgo County since 2003. Many homes near downtown and along Closner Boulevard and McColl Road were built decades ago, and their original shingle roofs are reaching the end of their life. On the north side, newer homes are more often replaced after storm damage.

A full replacement is the right call when a roof is past patching: widespread granule loss, several repair points, storm damage across a large area, or simple age once a shingle system passes 20 to 25 years in this climate. We inspect the whole roof and the decking underneath before we recommend replacement over repair, not the other way around.

Every replacement includes a full tear off, a decking inspection for water damage, and a written scope before we start. If you are already thinking about gutters, see gutter installation and repair in Edinburg.

cards.title: Full tear off and replacement
cards.body: Complete removal of the old roofing down to the decking, a check for water damage, and installation of a new shingle system with a written scope and timeline.

cards.title: CertainTeed, Owens Corning, and GAF shingles
cards.body: We install shingle systems from all three major manufacturers. We are the only CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster in the Rio Grande Valley, a certification tied to installation quality and warranty coverage.

cards.title: Decking repair and replacement
cards.body: Water damaged or rotted decking found during tear off is repaired or replaced before the new roof goes on. It gets documented, not covered up.

cards.title: Ventilation and underlayment upgrades
cards.body: Good attic ventilation and modern synthetic underlayment matter in Edinburg's heat. We can upgrade both during a replacement to extend the life of the new roof.

cards.title: New construction and remodel roofing
cards.body: Roofing for new builds and additions on the north side of Edinburg, coordinated with builders and general contractors.

cards.title: Insurance replacement support
cards.body: When a replacement is being paid through a storm damage claim, we document our findings clearly so you know what to present to your insurance company.

sections.title: Why Edinburg roofs need replacing sooner than you might expect
paras: Heat and constant sun age a shingle roof faster in the Rio Grande Valley than in most of the country. A 20 year shingle here often behaves more like a 15 year shingle by the time it is inspected. That is what we see most in older neighborhoods near downtown: original roofs well past their realistic life, even when they do not look bad from the street.

In newer areas on the north side, replacements are more often storm driven. Hail or wind damage across enough of the roof makes patching a poor use of money compared with a full replacement covered by insurance.

Either way, we walk the whole roof before recommending replacement, and we tell you plainly if a repair would do the job. Our roof replacement guide for Edinburg explains the process and what to expect, and roof repair in Edinburg covers the cases where a repair is enough.

faqs.q: How do I know if my Edinburg roof needs replacing instead of repairing?
faqs.a: Widespread granule loss, several leak points, a roof over 20 to 25 years old, or storm damage across a large section of the roof are the usual signs. We inspect the whole roof and the decking and give you an honest recommendation, not an automatic push toward replacement.

faqs.q: How much does a roof replacement cost in Edinburg?
faqs.a: For a typical Edinburg home, a full shingle replacement generally runs between $8,000 and $18,000, depending on roof size, pitch, current material, and shingle grade. We give a written estimate before any work begins.

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most residential replacements in Edinburg take one to three days depending on roof size and complexity, weather permitting. You get a specific timeline in the written scope before work starts.

faqs.q: What shingle brands do you install in Edinburg?
faqs.a: CertainTeed, Owens Corning, and GAF. We are the only CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster in the Rio Grande Valley, which reflects installation training and gives access to stronger warranty coverage on CertainTeed systems.

faqs.q: How do I get a roof replacement estimate in Edinburg?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. We walk the roof, measure, and give you a written estimate. Estimates are free with no obligation.
